recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant core Bundle version prose for this old DSTU2 issue unless a new work group decision asks for a distinct document Bundle version element or changes the post-R5 Composition.version approach.
issue_request: FHIR-12054 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU2. It asked for explicit FHIR document Bundle identifier, document date, and version semantics independent of mutable REST metadata, with the resolution recording that Bundle.identifier was now on the latest Bundle and that a Composition versionId extension would be explored in C-CDA on FHIR.
initial_application: No commit explicitly names FHIR-12054. The identifier portion was implicitly applied through same-change-family FHIR-12162 in git commit 88db4c7805d907c61bc750d3694adeaadb784063, which changed the document narrative from Bundle.id to Bundle.identifier. Current Bundle source also defines Bundle.identifier and Bundle.timestamp with document-specific semantics.
additional_context: FHIR-12162 added Bundle.identifier. FHIR-13356 addressed ClinicalDocument versionNumber as a Composition extension, later R5 work added Composition.version mapped to CDA .versionNumber, and FHIR-34407/FHIR-38201 concluded the old extension was no longer needed in R5/R6 because Composition.version exists. The Extension Pack still carries composition-clinicaldocument-versionNumber for pre-R5 use.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source is already correct. The document page names Bundle.identifier as the mandatory document identifier and Bundle.timestamp as the mandatory document date; Bundle source backs those semantics; Composition.version covers the versionNumber concept in current core.

related_jiras.note: Added Bundle.identifier for persistent document Bundle identity, satisfying the identifier part of FHIR-12054.
